<!--
================================================================================
  GOAL
  ----
  Apply Reduced K-Means (RKM) clustering to user embedding vectors from the
  MovieLens 1M dataset, available at three dimensionalities (64, 128, 256).
  RKM simultaneously finds cluster assignments and a low-dimensional subspace
  (of dimension q) that best separates those clusters, using varimax rotation
  for interpretability. This notebook performs a grid search over the number
  of clusters (k) and the reduced dimension (q), selects the best (k, q)
  combination by Average Silhouette Width (Calinski-Harabasz as tiebreaker),
  and saves cluster assignments plus all intermediate results.

  HOW IT WORKS
  ------------
  1. Setup       – Load libraries, create output directories, define embedding
                   paths and the (k, q) search grid.
  2. Load helper – load_rkm_cached_results() reconstructs a full result object
                   from per-(k, q) cache files, for use when the full-result
                   cache is absent.
  3. Fit/Cache   – For every (embedding, k, q) triple:
                     a. Check for a per-(k, q) .rds cache; load it if present.
                     b. Otherwise run cluspca() with method = "RKM", compute
                        Silhouette and CH, then save to cache.
  4. Select      – Within each embedding, pick the (k, q) pair with the
                   highest Silhouette; break ties with CH.
  5. Visualize   – Plot Silhouette and CH tuning curves (over q, coloured by
                   k), silhouette bar plots for the best model, and PCA
                   projections of the best cluster assignments.
  6. Save        – Write cluster assignment CSVs, tuning grid CSVs, and
                   serialised model objects (.rds) for each embedding.
================================================================================
-->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.width = 9,
  fig.height = 6,
  dpi = 120
)
set.seed(42)
```

# 1. Requirements
```{r requirements}
required_packages <- c(
  "readr", "dplyr", "ggplot2",
  "cluster",    # silhouette()
  "factoextra", # fviz_* helpers
  "clustrd"     # cluspca() – implements RKM
)

installed    <- rownames(installed.packages())
missing_pkgs <- setdiff(required_packages, installed)

if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) {
  install.packages(missing_pkgs)
}

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(cluster)
library(factoextra)
library(clustrd)
```

# 2. Load embeddings files

```{r load}
# Paths to the three pre-computed user embedding CSV files
embedding_paths <- c(
  "output/embeddings/user_embeddings_64.csv",
  "output/embeddings/user_embeddings_128.csv",
  "output/embeddings/user_embeddings_256.csv"
)

# Search grid: k = number of clusters, q = reduced subspace dimension
k_range <- 2:10
q_range <- 2:6

# Master list accumulating per-embedding results throughout the notebook
all_results <- list()

# Create output directories upfront so write steps never fail
dir.create("output/rkm_cache",   recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("output/rkm_plots",   recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("output/rkm_results", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```


# 3. Load saved RKM results
```{r run-rkm}
# Reconstruct a full result object from per-(k, q) cache files.
# Used as a fallback when the full-result cache does not exist yet but
# individual (k, q) cells have already been computed.
# Returns NULL if no valid cached cells are found.
load_rkm_cached_results <- function(embedding_path) {
  embeddings       <- read_csv(embedding_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  user_ids         <- embeddings[[1]]
  embedding_matrix <- scale(as.matrix(embeddings[, -1]))
  embedding_tag    <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(embedding_path))

  # If the full-result cache exists, use it directly
  full_file <- file.path(
    "output/rkm_cache",
    paste0("rkm_full_result_", embedding_tag, ".rds")
  )
  if (file.exists(full_file)) return(readRDS(full_file))

  dmat <- dist(embedding_matrix)

  # Initialise the results grid and model storage
  results_grid             <- expand.grid(k = k_range, q = q_range)
  results_grid$Silhouette  <- NA_real_
  results_grid$CH          <- NA_real_
  results_grid$runtime_sec <- NA_real_
  results_grid$status      <- "ok"
  results_grid$notes       <- NA_character_

  rkm_models <- vector("list", nrow(results_grid))

  # Load each cached (k, q) cell if it exists
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(results_grid))) {
    k_val <- results_grid$k[i]
    q_val <- results_grid$q[i]

    cache_file <- file.path(
      "output/rkm_cache",
      paste0("rkm_", embedding_tag, "_k", k_val, "_q", q_val, ".rds")
    )

    if (!file.exists(cache_file)) next

    cached <- readRDS(cache_file)
    results_grid$Silhouette[i] <- cached$Silhouette
    results_grid$CH[i]         <- cached$CH
    rkm_models[[i]]            <- cached$model
  }

  # Return NULL if no cells were successfully loaded
  valid_rows <- which(!is.na(results_grid$Silhouette))
  if (length(valid_rows) == 0) return(NULL)

  # Select the best (k, q) by Silhouette
  best_index      <- which.max(results_grid$Silhouette)
  best_params     <- results_grid[best_index, ]
  best_k          <- best_params$k
  best_q          <- best_params$q
  best_silhouette <- best_params$Silhouette
  best_rkm        <- rkm_models[[best_index]]

  cluster_df <- data.frame(UserID = user_ids, Cluster = best_rkm$cluster)
  best_sil   <- silhouette(best_rkm$cluster, dmat)

  # PCA projection for visualisation
  pca          <- prcomp(embedding_matrix)
  var_explained <- summary(pca)$importance[2, 1:2]
  pca_df <- data.frame(
    PC1     = pca$x[, 1],
    PC2     = pca$x[, 2],
    Cluster = as.factor(best_rkm$cluster)
  )

  list(
    embedding_path   = embedding_path,
    embedding_tag    = embedding_tag,
    embedding_matrix = embedding_matrix,
    user_ids         = user_ids,
    results_grid     = results_grid,
    best_index       = best_index,
    best_params      = best_params,
    best_k           = best_k,
    best_q           = best_q,
    best_silhouette  = best_silhouette,
    best_rkm         = best_rkm,
    best_sil         = best_sil,
    cluster_df       = cluster_df,
    dmat             = dmat,
    pca_df           = pca_df,
    var_explained    = var_explained
  )
}
```

# 4. Fit embeddings with caching
```{r fit-rkm}
# ── Outer loop: iterate over each embedding dimensionality ───────────────────
all_results <- list()

for (embedding_path in embedding_paths) {

  if (!file.exists(embedding_path)) {
    cat("Missing file:", embedding_path, "\n")
    next
  }

  cat("\nProcessing:", embedding_path, "\n")
  embedding_t0 <- Sys.time()

  # Load and z-score the embedding matrix; first column is UserID
  embeddings       <- read_csv(embedding_path)
  user_ids         <- embeddings[[1]]
  embedding_matrix <- scale(embeddings[, -1])
  embedding_tag    <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(embedding_path))

  # Path for the full serialised result (bypasses the inner (k,q) loop)
  full_file <- file.path(
    "output/rkm_cache",
    paste0("rkm_full_result_", embedding_tag, ".rds")
  )

  if (file.exists(full_file)) {
    cat("Loading FULL cached result for:", embedding_tag, "\n")
    all_results[[embedding_tag]] <- readRDS(full_file)
    next
  }

  # Precompute the distance matrix once; reused for every silhouette call
  dmat <- dist(embedding_matrix)

  # Initialise results grid for all (k, q) combinations
  results_grid             <- expand.grid(k = k_range, q = q_range)
  results_grid$Silhouette  <- NA_real_
  results_grid$CH          <- NA_real_
  rkm_models               <- vector("list", nrow(results_grid))

  # ── Inner loop: grid search over (k, q) ─────────────────────────────────
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(results_grid))) {
    k_val <- results_grid$k[i]
    q_val <- results_grid$q[i]

    cache_file <- file.path(
      "output/rkm_cache",
      paste0("rkm_", embedding_tag, "_k", k_val, "_q", q_val, ".rds")
    )

    if (file.exists(cache_file)) {
      # ── Cache hit: load pre-computed metrics ────────────────────────────
      cat("Loading cached result for", embedding_tag, "k =", k_val, "q =", q_val, "\n")
      cached  <- readRDS(cache_file)
      model   <- cached$model
      avg_sil <- cached$Silhouette
      ch_val  <- cached$CH

    } else {
      # ── Cache miss: fit RKM and compute evaluation metrics ───────────────
      cat("Running RKM for", embedding_tag, "k =", k_val, "q =", q_val, "\n")

      t0 <- Sys.time()

      # cluspca() with method = "RKM" simultaneously clusters and reduces dims.
      # varimax rotation improves interpretability of the reduced axes.
      # Errors/warnings are caught so one bad cell won't abort the grid search.
      model <- tryCatch(
        cluspca(
          embedding_matrix,
          nclus    = k_val,
          ndim     = q_val,
          method   = "RKM",
          rotation = "varimax"
        ),
        warning = function(w) {
          results_grid$status[i] <<- "warning"
          results_grid$notes[i]  <<- conditionMessage(w)
          invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
        },
        error = function(e) {
          results_grid$status[i] <<- "error"
          results_grid$notes[i]  <<- conditionMessage(e)
          NULL
        }
      )

      results_grid$runtime_sec[i] <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))

      if (is.null(model)) next

      # Average Silhouette Width
      sil     <- silhouette(model$cluster, dmat)
      avg_sil <- mean(sil[, 3])

      # Calinski-Harabasz index
      ch_val <- intCriteria(
        traj = embedding_matrix,
        part = as.integer(model$cluster),
        crit = "Calinski_Harabasz"
      )$calinski_harabasz

      # Persist so this cell is never re-computed
      saveRDS(
        list(
          model          = model,
          Silhouette     = avg_sil,
          CH             = ch_val,
          runtime_sec    = results_grid$runtime_sec[i],
          status         = results_grid$status[i],
          notes          = results_grid$notes[i],
          k              = k_val,
          q              = q_val,
          embedding_path = embedding_path
        ),
        cache_file
      )
    }

    results_grid$Silhouette[i] <- avg_sil
    results_grid$CH[i]         <- ch_val
    rkm_models[[i]]            <- model
  }

  # ── Select best (k, q) for this embedding ───────────────────────────────
  best_index      <- which.max(results_grid$Silhouette)
  best_params     <- results_grid[best_index, ]
  best_k          <- best_params$k
  best_q          <- best_params$q
  best_silhouette <- best_params$Silhouette
  best_rkm        <- rkm_models[[best_index]]

  cluster_df <- data.frame(UserID = user_ids, Cluster = best_rkm$cluster)
  best_sil   <- silhouette(best_rkm$cluster, dmat)

  # PCA projection for visualisation (computed on the full embedding matrix)
  pca           <- prcomp(embedding_matrix)
  var_explained <- summary(pca)$importance[2, 1:2]
  pca_df <- data.frame(
    PC1     = pca$x[, 1],
    PC2     = pca$x[, 2],
    Cluster = as.factor(best_rkm$cluster)
  )

  runtime_total_sec <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), embedding_t0, units = "secs"))
  cluster_sizes     <- table(cluster_df$Cluster)

  # Collect any warning/error messages from the grid search
  notes_text <- NA_character_
  if ("notes" %in% names(results_grid)) {
    tmp_notes <- unique(na.omit(results_grid$notes))
    if (length(tmp_notes) > 0) notes_text <- paste(tmp_notes, collapse = " | ")
  }

  # One-row summary for cross-embedding and cross-method comparisons
  summary_row <- data.frame(
    method            = "RKM",
    embedding         = embedding_tag,
    best_k            = best_k,
    best_q            = best_q,
    silhouette        = best_params$Silhouette,
    CH                = best_params$CH,
    prob_silh         = NA,   # not applicable for RKM
    cluster_size_min  = min(cluster_sizes),
    cluster_size_max  = max(cluster_sizes),
    cluster_size_sd   = sd(as.numeric(cluster_sizes)),
    runtime_total_sec = runtime_total_sec,
    notes             = notes_text
  )

  # Store all artefacts for this embedding in the master list
  all_results[[embedding_tag]] <- list(
    embedding_path    = embedding_path,
    embedding_tag     = embedding_tag,
    embedding_matrix  = embedding_matrix,
    user_ids          = user_ids,
    results_grid      = results_grid,
    best_index        = best_index,
    best_params       = best_params,
    best_k            = best_k,
    best_q            = best_q,
    best_silhouette   = best_silhouette,
    best_rkm          = best_rkm,
    best_sil          = best_sil,
    cluster_df        = cluster_df,
    dmat              = dmat,
    pca_df            = pca_df,
    var_explained     = var_explained,
    runtime_total_sec = runtime_total_sec,
    summary_row       = summary_row,
    # Placeholder fields for optional stability analysis (multi-seed runs)
    stability_info    = list(
      seeds_tested      = NA,
      n_runs            = NA,
      chosen_k_values   = NA,
      chosen_q_values   = NA,
      ari_mean          = NA,
      ari_sd            = NA,
      stability_notes   = NA_character_
    )
  )

  cat("Saved results for:", embedding_tag, "\n")
}
```

# 5. Show results for all embeddings
```{r results-rkm}
# Print a concise summary for each embedding: best hyperparameters, quality
# metrics, and the raw cluster size distribution.
for (name in names(all_results)) {
  res <- all_results[[name]]

  cat("\n==========", name, "==========\n")
  cat("Best k:", res$best_k, "\n")
  cat("Best q:", res$best_q, "\n")
  cat("Best silhouette:", res$best_params$Silhouette, "\n")
  cat("Best CH:", res$best_params$CH, "\n")
  cat("Cluster sizes:\n")
  print(table(res$cluster_df$Cluster))
}
```

# 6. Plot tuning results for all embeddings
```{r plot-tuning}
# Line plots of Silhouette and CH across the (k, q) grid for each embedding.
for (name in names(all_results)) {
  res <- all_results[[name]]

  # ── Silhouette vs. q (one line per k) ──────────────────────────────────
  p1 <- ggplot(res$results_grid, aes(x = q, y = Silhouette, color = factor(k), group = k)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = paste("Silhouette by q and k -", name),
      x     = "Reduced Dimension (q)",
      y     = "Average Silhouette Width",
      color = "Clusters (k)"
    )

  print(p1)
  ggsave(file.path("output/rkm_plots", paste0("silhouette_", name, ".png")),
         p1, width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 120)

  # ── Calinski-Harabasz vs. q (one line per k) ────────────────────────────
  p2 <- ggplot(res$results_grid, aes(x = q, y = CH, color = factor(k), group = k)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = paste("CH by q and k -", name),
      x     = "Reduced Dimension (q)",
      y     = "Calinski-Harabasz Index",
      color = "Clusters (k)"
    )

  print(p2)
  ggsave(file.path("output/rkm_plots", paste0("ch_", name, ".png")),
         p2, width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 120)
}
```

# 7. Plot silhouette for best models
```{r plot-sil}
# Classic silhouette bar plot for the best (k, q) model from each embedding.
# Saved to disk and also rendered inline.
for (name in names(all_results)) {
  res <- all_results[[name]]

  png(
    filename = file.path(
      "output/rkm_plots",
      paste0("silhouette_plot_", name, "_k", res$best_k, "_q", res$best_q, ".png")
    ),
    width = 1200, height = 800, res = 120
  )

  plot(
    res$best_sil,
    main   = paste("Reduced K-Means Silhouette Plot -", name,
                   "(k =", res$best_k, ", q =", res$best_q, ")"),
    col    = "blue",
    border = NA
  )

  dev.off()

  # Render inline as well
  plot(
    res$best_sil,
    main   = paste("Reduced K-Means Silhouette Plot -", name,
                   "(k =", res$best_k, ", q =", res$best_q, ")"),
    col    = "blue",
    border = NA
  )
}
```

# 8. Plot PCA for all embeddings
```{r pca}
# Project each embedding's best cluster solution onto its first two principal
# components, coloured by cluster assignment. Axis labels include % variance
# explained by each PC.
for (name in names(all_results)) {
  res <- all_results[[name]]

  p_pca <- ggplot(res$pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Cluster)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = paste("Reduced K-Means Clusters (PCA Projection) -", name,
                    "k =", res$best_k, ", q =", res$best_q),
      x = paste0("PC1 (", round(100 * res$var_explained[1], 1), "%)"),
      y = paste0("PC2 (", round(100 * res$var_explained[2], 1), "%)")
    )

  print(p_pca)
  ggsave(
    file.path("output/rkm_plots",
              paste0("pca_", name, "_k", res$best_k, "_q", res$best_q, ".png")),
    p_pca, width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 120
  )
}
```

# 9. Choose best overall embedding
```{r best-rkm}
# Collect the best-parameter row from every embedding and select the single
# best overall model: highest Silhouette, then highest CH as tiebreaker.
all_best <- lapply(all_results, function(res) {
  data.frame(
    embedding  = res$embedding_tag,
    best_k     = res$best_k,
    best_q     = res$best_q,
    Silhouette = res$best_params$Silhouette,
    CH         = res$best_params$CH
  )
})

all_best_df <- bind_rows(all_best)
print(all_best_df)

best_overall_index <- with(all_best_df, order(-Silhouette, -CH))[1]
best_overall       <- all_best_df[best_overall_index, ]
print(best_overall)

# Pull full result for the winning embedding for use in downstream notebooks
best_name       <- best_overall$embedding
best_res        <- all_results[[best_name]]
best_rkm        <- best_res$best_rkm
best_cluster_df <- best_res$cluster_df
best_pca_df     <- best_res$pca_df
best_k          <- best_res$best_k
best_q          <- best_res$best_q
```

# 10. Save per-embedding results
```{r save}
# Persist all artefacts for downstream use and reproducibility:
#   • cluster assignment CSVs  (UserID → Cluster)
#   • tuning grid CSVs         (all k/q combinations with their metrics)
#   • serialised best model    (.rds for the best RKM object per embedding)
#   • serialised full result   (complete result list for cache-based reloading)

for (name in names(all_results)) {
  res <- all_results[[name]]

  # Cluster assignments for this embedding's best model
  write.csv(
    res$cluster_df,
    file      = file.path("output/rkm_results",
                          paste0("rkm_clusters_", name, "_k", res$best_k, "_q", res$best_q, ".csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  # Full tuning grid results for this embedding
  write.csv(
    res$results_grid,
    file      = file.path("output/rkm_results",
                          paste0("rkm_tuning_results_", name, ".csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  # Serialised best RKM model object
  saveRDS(
    res$best_rkm,
    file = file.path("output/rkm_cache",
                     paste0("best_rkm_", name, "_k", res$best_k, "_q", res$best_q, ".rds"))
  )

  # Serialised full result list (used by comparison notebooks without re-fitting)
  saveRDS(
    res,
    file = file.path("output/rkm_cache",
                     paste0("rkm_full_result_", name, ".rds"))
  )
}

# Cluster assignments for the single best overall model
write.csv(
  best_cluster_df,
  file      = file.path("output/rkm_results",
                        paste0("rkm_best_overall_clusters_", best_name,
                               "_k", best_k, "_q", best_q, ".csv")),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Cross-embedding comparison of best (k, q) per embedding
write.csv(
  all_best_df,
  file      = file.path("output/rkm_results", "rkm_best_overall_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# One-row-per-embedding summary table for cross-method comparison
all_summary_df <- bind_rows(lapply(all_results, function(x) x$summary_row))

write.csv(
  all_summary_df,
  file      = file.path("output/rkm_results", "rkm_summary_table.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
